subject: Civic Education
competence: Explains the diversity of world of work. Activity “Let’s undentify world of work” Time 40 minutes
lesson: Explains the diversity of world of work. Activity “Let’s undentify world of work” Time 40 minutes: Consensus Problem-Solving Carousel: Competency Level 8.6.1
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the diversity of world of work. Activity “Let’s undentify world of work” Time 40 minutes
the_entrance: 5-minute introduction: As we explore the world of work, let's identify the diverse jobs available in our society. Can you think of some jobs that you know?

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Organizes students into 8 teams (8 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students negotiate a solution, create a shared civic artifact, and review another group's proposal.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Circulates across 8 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students continue to negotiate, create, and review their proposals.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Monitors progress and provides feedback to students.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students present their proposals to the class and receive feedback from peers.

summary: Students will negotiate a solution, create a shared civic artifact, and review another group's proposal.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Formative feedback criteria: Does the group's proposal demonstrate an understanding of the diversity of the world of work?
post_activity: 5-minute in-class assignment: Students will reflect on their learning and share their thoughts with the class.
selected_activity:
Activity: Consensus Problem-Solving Carousel: Competency Level 8.6.1
Approach: Students use consensus problem-solving carousel to explore 'Explains the diversity of world of work. Activity “Let’s undentify world of work” Time 40 minutes'. Students negotiate a solution, create a shared civic artifact, and review another group's proposal. Standard class layout (40 students): Desks arranged into 8 teams (8 teams (8 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Student task: Students negotiate a solution, create a shared civic artifact, and review another group's proposal. Standard class layout (40 students): Desks arranged into 8 teams (8 teams (8 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Teacher facilitation: Organizes all 40 students using 8 teams (8 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer. and monitors progress with outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Circulates across 8 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
Expected output: A group civic proposal, diagram, or public information message.
Grouping: 8 teams (8 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
